The glossary maps it to Delivery CSAT for customers.","evidence_quote":"Customer happiness: from 4.0 to 4.4 within 12 weeks.","citations":["metrics-glossary#deprecated-and-ambiguous-terms"],"recommendation":"Replace it with Delivery CSAT, or another canonical metric, and restate the baseline and target in that metric's terms."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Responsible AI review not recorded","detail":"The proposal deploys an LLM/GenAI chatbot on customer order data, which triggers the Responsible AI review requirement. The proposal records no such review, and only says vendor selection is in progress.","evidence_quote":"Deploy a GenAI chatbot using an LLM that identifies the customer by phone number and answers order status questions from order history.","citations":["policy-compliance#generative-ai-with-company-data"],"recommendation":"Complete and record a Responsible AI review covering approved models, data handling and human oversight before launch."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Privacy review not recorded","detail":"The chatbot identifies customers by phone number and accesses order history, which is personal data and requires a Privacy review. None is recorded.","evidence_quote":"identifies the customer by phone number","citations":["policy-compliance#customer-location-and-personal-data"],"recommendation":"Complete and record a Privacy review (DPIA) covering purpose limitation, retention and authentication by phone number."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Unsourced 60% deflection claim","detail":"The 60% contact deflection figure is stated as an expectation with no source, benchmark or prior data.","evidence_quote":"We expect the chatbot to deflect 60% of contacts.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite a vendor benchmark, pilot data or analysis supporting the estimate, or remove it."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Test duration under 14 days minimum","detail":"The 3-week duration meets the 14-day minimum, but the success metric's 12-week target horizon is not covered by the plan. The plan also does not specify an MDE or power for the primary success metric: the stated MDE is in contacts per 100 and not in the success metric.","evidence_quote":"MDE: 0.5 contacts per 100, power 80%. Primary metric and stopping rule pre-registered.","citations":["experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Pre-register the MDE and power for the actual primary metric (e.g., Delivery CSAT) and align the test duration with the success-metric timeframe."}]}
